channel.title: Mobile Capture beta updates
channel.description: Internal development betas. Ad-hoc signed and not notarized.

item.title: v0.1.2-beta.3
item.description:
New Mobile Capture icon

  • New teal-and-gold app icon with a transparent surround and all standard macOS sizes.
  • Setup guides, installers, release links and new update packages now use raymondctc/mobile-capture.
  • The update publisher preserves signed history from before the repository transfer and keeps the existing signing key.

To test, open a released beta 1 or beta 2, choose Mobile Capture → Check for Updates…, then install and relaunch. Local preview builds have updates disabled.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later. The app includes the capture engine, Python and Android tools. Physical-iPhone USB logging uses external tools; Simulator capture requires Xcode. Phone certificate trust and VPN approval remain manual steps.

Internal development beta: ad-hoc signed and not notarized. Initial macOS approval may be required. Update archives and the feed use the existing Sparkle signing key, kept locally in Keychain. Automatic update checks start off.

item.title: v0.1.2-beta.2
item.description:
Internal beta update test

This beta uses the same reviewed code as beta 1, with a new beta label and build number so you can test download, installation and relaunch.

  • Check for updates from the Mobile Capture menu or Settings.
  • Installation waits for captures, saving, setup and recovery to finish.
  • Saved captures, certificates and phone tunnel profiles stay in their existing locations.

To reproduce the upgrade, install beta 1, then choose Check for Updates. This is beta 2, build 3001.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later. This internal development build is ad-hoc signed and not notarized. Initial macOS approval remains a user step. Automatic checks start off; installation requires your choice.

item.title: v0.1.2-beta.1
item.description:
Install and diagnose with an agent from the repository URL using [Agent Setup](https://github.com/am5a03/mobile-capture/blob/main/docs/AGENT_SETUP.md).
Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26+. The ZIP includes the capture engine, embedded Python and Android tools. Physical iPhone USB logging needs separate supported tools; Simulator capture needs Xcode. Phone certificate trust and VPN approval remain user steps. JSON Doctor reports Mac prerequisites, not phone readiness.
**Development beta: ad-hoc signed and not notarized.** Install only if you trust this project and explicitly accept development builds. macOS can block execution; the installer reports a manual approval handoff and never bypasses Gatekeeper. Beta-tag packages include manual Sparkle updates. An update becomes available only after the maintainer signs the final public archive and publishes its signed feed locally. The private beta key stays in the maintainer's Keychain. Existing v0.1.1-beta.1 needs a one-time install to gain the updater. This beta is for setup testing. Simulator Doctor can report an installed Xcode shell launcher as incompatible; the read-only check never runs first-launch setup. Fresh-Mac and full device acceptance remain outstanding.
## What's Changed * feat(updates): add signed Sparkle updates for internal betas by @am5a03 in https://github.com/am5a03/mobile-capture/pull/3
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/am5a03/mobile-capture/compare/v0.1.1-beta.1...v0.1.2-beta.1
## Test the in-app update
Install this updater-enabled beta once, then choose **Mobile Capture → Check for Updates…** to install [v0.1.2-beta.2](https://github.com/am5a03/mobile-capture/releases/tag/v0.1.2-beta.2). Initial macOS approval remains a user step for this unnotarized development build.
Automatic checks start off, and installation requires a user choice. Capture, save, setup, Doctor and recovery work prevent an update from replacing active helpers. The signed update feed is published locally after verification; the private update key stays in the maintainer’s Keychain.
Implementation: [PR #3](https://github.com/am5a03/mobile-capture/pull/3).
